## Publication Information

**Date:** 1862

**Genre:** Fiction

**Publisher:** Groombridge and Sons, 5, Paternoster Row, London.

**Notes:** This contained ‘The Sea Spleenwort’, ‘The Mice at Play’ and ‘The Strayed Falcon’. A number of other Magnet stories by others seem also to have been bound up in this way and published in Groombridge’s gift book series (in which <i>Historical Dramas</i> also appeared).
